title: Fresh loop80 confirmation of total96 lexical cycle budget

cohort.exclusions: None. No source failures selected or fresh input exclusions. Exactly4096 generated independent inputs, all three fixed model seeds on all inputs. No replacement, sample extension, repeated test fitting or pooling. Input uniqueness, independently recomputed shortest labels and zero exact token-hash overlap with every dataset in the sealed prior registry required before GPU outcomes.

arm_grouping: BP uses its separately trained fixed continued-PL AdamW checkpoints. All LP arms use precisely the same respective norm-matched H2ae checkpoints for seeds0,1,2; no retraining/new model draw. Frozen hidden solver/readout shared when identical. The three checkpoints are repeated measurements, not independent statistical trials.

inference.BP: Float32 native u=3,eta=.5,max8192iterations,check16; original float64 flip margin>=-1e-6,finite/native-stopped/hiddenconverged,independent valid shortest path. Same control as H2be.
inference.hidden: Unchanged float32 settle tol1e-6,cap4000,check8; exact original float32 coupling readout promoted losslessly for LP.
inference.LP: Float64 original energy, four parity colors, negative flips<-1e-8,512native sweeps,full no-flip sweep stop. Unchanged raw maximal selected-free global-degree1/2 chains2..256, negative-energy connectivity veto16, corrected unified16 eligibility, further32cycles to48, then16to64 then32to96. Lexical chosen-cell ordering, every native suffix and exact terminal candidate-absence checks retained. H2bf bridge veto and H2bd lexical geometry are exact implementation accelerations. No label or shortest-distance routing.
inference.failures: Any hidden/nonfinite/nativecap/blockcap failure or invalid/nonshortest output is failure; flags never cleared without the same candidate-absence terminal rule, nativecaps never certified away.

unit_and_joint_success: For input i and arm a, Y_ia=1 iff all three fixed models independently satisfy finite/stopped/hiddenconverged/original-margin>=-1e-6 and valid-shortest output. Thus joint success is the intersection (logical AND), not the union, across models. N=4096 independent maze inputs for all inference.

statistics.CP: For k successes among N, L_alpha(k)=0 when k=0 else BetaInv(alpha;k,N-k+1); U_alpha(k)=1 when k=N else BetaInv(1-alpha;k+1,N-k). Each [L_alpha,U_alpha] reports separate one-sided(1-alpha) bounds, not a joint two-sided95 interval.
statistics.paired_net: For candidate X/control C, g=sum(X=1,C=0),l=sum(X=0,C=1). Report net100*(g-l)/N pp. Separately one-sided95 net lower=100*(L_.025(g)-U_.025(l));upper=100*(U_.025(g)-L_.025(l)) by marginal Bonferroni. Support if lower>=threshold; falsify if upper<threshold; otherwise inconclusive.
statistics.multiplicity: Four accuracy endpoints and one measured cost endpoint decided separately. No familywise95 or omnibus confidence claim;64 is descriptive. Retain all paired BP losses even if net noninferiority supports.

absolute96.bounds: CP alpha.05 on k=sum(Y96);support L>=99.9%,falsify U<99.9%,otherwise inconclusive

regression96_vs48.bounds: CP alpha.05 on loss count;support U<=0.1%,falsify L>0.1%,otherwise inconclusive

cost_endpoint.hypothesis: Aggregate measured charged answer overhead(total96 versus total48)<=10%.
cost_endpoint.decision: Supported iff measured overhead<=10%,otherwise falsified. One fixed fresh-cohort accounting observation, no timing confidence interval or hardware-general speed claim.
cost_endpoint.scope: CUDA-synchronized complete answer prefix cost: initialization/cache, finite-margin eligibility/routing, all candidate geometry/scoring, every native suffix and terminal checks, and returned output arrays. All stages needed to produce each arm charged in full even when executed once. BP charged its full separate native solver. Report all BP/48/64/96 costs. Hidden solve, input transfer/model load, diagnostics and archiving also measured/reported separately.
cost_endpoint.sharing: Within each batch, BP and LP prefix execution order alternate deterministically by job/batch. LP binary+veto+unified16+48 executes once;48board/flags retained exactly. Eligible48caps continue16 to64;eligible64caps continue32 to96. Each arm charged all previous LP stages and own copies/routing. Archive/audit not charged to decoder.

gates.before_freeze: Passed seed registry plus independent statistics boundary tests for all accuracy decisions. New source hashes, exact helper, budgets, model hashes and source dependencies frozen before source outcome gate and fresh draws.
gates.fast_geometry: Hash-bind H2bd/H2bf exhaustive/archive/full-policy exact parity receipts. New integrated helper at48must reproduce original H2be archived shard00/all256inputs/all3seeds: all prefix boards/counters/flags/geometry/costs/choices/native and terminal traces. Existing H2bf confirms fast versus legacy veto equivalence.
gates.continuation_integration: Compare integrated16+32 continuation stages on all148H2bg cap starts against H2bg archived64/96 outputs, all choices/costs/states/counters/native/block/terminal flags. Model grouping/batching must preserve every case, including all42remaining64caps. Also retain source48 ordinary unchanged states via full shard00gate.
gates.fresh_draw_gate: Both protocol-bound source gates must pass, then generate4096fresh inputs, then independent input audit must pass before any fresh GPU evaluation.

audit_and_reporting: Retain and independently audit every fresh final state and every required LP prefix candidate/cost/choice/native transition/terminal flag; original margin, graph shortestness, hiddenflags, budgets, fullprefix accounting and model/input identity. Final arm counts use four reported policies; intermediate LP prefix states are internal evidence. All failure/cap traces retained. Export fixed index-based public fixtures and independent statistical/graph/energy checks with production imports blocked. BP AdamW first in every comparison.
